_comment: The sampling matrix from docs/study-design-decisions.md §1, as data rather than prose,
so the dashboard can show a live quota gap and the field team can act on it the same day.
Targets are stated per CELL, not as a total with a note about representativeness.
A total alone is what lets a study finish 'on target' with nothing from Afar, and that
failure is invisible until analysis. Each cell names the variable it is defined over,
so the dashboard reads the respondent's own answer rather than a separate field the
enumerator has to remember to set.
Where 'census' is true the stratum is small enough to enumerate completely and the
target is the whole population; what can go wrong there is response rate, not sampling
error, and the dashboard labels it accordingly.

ORG.note: Strata over the S3 organisation type. Financial institutions, public universities and federal bodies are enumerable and are taken as a census; the rest are sampled proportional to size with deliberate oversampling of the five sectors the analysis compares.

IND.note: Dual-frame. The two arms are opened together so that arm is not confounded with fielding week, and are sized so neither can be dismissed as a footnote to the other.

secondary.note: Monitored, not quota-enforced: a quota on location inside a referral chain would break the RDS assumptions the chain exists to satisfy.

CIT.note: 1,500 online panel plus an 800-response enumerator booster. The booster is the anchor the panel is calibrated to; it is quota-controlled by region and settlement type, with a deliberate rural majority because the panel has none.

arms.label: Referral panel
arms.note: pooled into the panel; kept distinguishable for chain analysis

booster_quota.note: Four regions plus Addis. Rural cells are the larger half by design: roughly three Ethiopians in four live rurally and none of them are on the Telegram panel.

calibration.note: The panel is raked to these margins and a propensity adjustment is estimated against the booster. Raw, calibrated and booster estimates are reported together, always; the spread between them is a finding about online measurement in Ethiopia, not a weighting appendix.

quality_thresholds.note: Phase 3 daily review triggers (docs/study-design-decisions.md §4). Crossing one pauses a channel; it does not stop the study.
